Market today: The mood is cautious, driven by a looming bond sell-off and inflation fears. This means higher rates, which typically hurt growth-oriented tech and chip names like yours.

Your holdings: SOXL (-58.06%) and SPAL (-31.73%) are leveraged and deeply in the red, needing immediate attention. SMH (-13.17%) and QQQI (-3.12%) also show losses. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yields and any further inflation data. These macro factors are the primary drivers for your concentrated tech book.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management in your leveraged and underperforming tech/chip positions.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or respecting the default stop at 200. This leveraged ETF is a major drag on your book.
SMH: Respect the stop at 540 or consider trimming as indicated by the scanner. Reduce exposure to chip sector risk.
SPAL: Monitor closely and respect the stop at 21.38. This new, leveraged position is already down significantly.
